Name: Bro Team Pill's Video Games Hat
Author: DruidSandstormBR
Description:
[i]Hi, this is a little mod I made that adds Bro Team Pill's Video Games Hat into Stardew Valley. The mod is made to replace the Trucker Cap, available from the Hat Mouse House after you get the achievement "Artisan" for crafting 30 different items.

[/i][b][i]This mod simply replaces the Trucker Cap model with a new model of the Video Games Hat.
While there was no modifying of code or anything like that I still recommend backing up your save file just in case something goes horribly wrong.[/i][/b]

I[b]nstallation: 
[u]1. Please Backup your save file and the Content folder before attempting to add this mod.
[/u][/b]2. Locate the Stardew Valley directory folder, usually in the Programs (x86) > Steam/GoG Folder > steamapps/Games.
3. Open the Content Folder, go to Characters > Farmer
4. Drag the hats.xnb file into the Farmer folder and have it over write/replace the original hats.xnb file.
5. Launch Stardew Valley and enjoy!

[i][b]If you have any problems or suggestions please leave them in the comments.
This mod was uploaded with the permission of Bro Team Pill.
[/b][/i] - DruidSandstormBR
